#### JO added (2026-11-09): DeiT-tiny (facebook/deit-tiny-distilled-patch16-224, ONNX, shapes fixed and constant-folded by
#### vtabundles_xcmpl/fold_onnx.py) on one EVTA; most of it on the CPU (VTASave generic CPU ops).
#### The bundle is generated by vtabundles_xcmpl/gen_deit_bundle.sh (it works around the unstable Glow graph hash of this
#### model, which the profile check of a plain model-compiler run hits at random) and built for the board in
#### vtabundles_xcmpl (collect_hw_bundles.py DeiTTest). This file only lists the executable for collect_hw_bundles.py.
set(DEIT_CPP ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/deit.cpp)
if(NOT EXISTS ${DEIT_CPP})
    message(STATUS "DeiTTest: ${DEIT_CPP} missing, skipped (vtabundles_xcmpl/gen_deit_bundle.sh)")
    return()
endif()

INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
add_executable(vtaDeiTBundle deitMain.cpp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/deit.cpp)
add_dependencies(vtaDeiTBundle ${BUNDLE_DEPENDS})
target_link_libraries(vtaDeiTBundle VTABundle png pthread ${BUNDLE_LINK_LIB})
set_target_properties(vtaDeiTBundle PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")

if(NESTC_EVTA_RUN_WITH_GENERIC_BUNDLE)
    add_nestc_test(ZCU102 NAME vtaDeiTBundle COMMAND ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/vtaDeiTBundle USE_SH 1 PARAMS ${GLOW_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/images/imagenet/cat_285.png)
else()
    add_nestc_test(NAME vtaDeiTBundle COMMAND ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/vtaDeiTBundle USE_SH 1 PARAMS ${GLOW_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/images/imagenet/cat_285.png)
endif()
